modules.name: exposure
modules.purpose: Brightens or darkens the whole photo, like changing exposure in camera.
modules.notes: compensate highlight preservation: shown when camera highlight bias > 0 (not machine-readable).

modules.name: white balance
modules.purpose: Makes neutral greys look neutral by setting the colour temperature and tint of the light the photo was taken under.
modules.notes: settings: darktable's default is '4 (as shot to reference) in scene-referred workflow, else 0 (as shot) - src/iop/temperature.c:1518'. finetune: shown when selected camera preset has fine-tuning entries; hard min/max/default reset to that preset's tuning range (not machine-readable). red: darktable's default is 'as-shot camera coefficient (reload_defaults, temperature.c:1513)'. red: shown when label 'green' on CYGM sensors (not machine-readable). green: darktable's default is 'as-shot camera coefficient'. green: shown when label 'magenta' on CYGM sensors (not machine-readable). blue: darktable's default is 'as-shot camera coefficient'. blue: shown when label 'cyan' on CYGM sensors (not machine-readable). emerald: darktable's default is 'as-shot camera coefficient'. emerald: shown when 4-bayer sensors only; label 'yellow' on CYGM sensors (not machine-readable). darktable shows some rows only on a tab, in a collapsible section or with a preference; that layout state is not part of visible_when.

modules.name: contrast brightness saturation
modules.purpose: Simple contrast, brightness and saturation sliders.
modules.notes: Deprecated upstream but kept in the curated block for existing styles; all three controls are curated.

modules.name: shadows and highlights
modules.purpose: Brightens dark areas and tames bright areas while keeping local contrast.

modules.name: tone equalizer
modules.purpose: Brightens or darkens specific brightness zones (shadows, mid-tones, highlights) while keeping local contrast.

modules.name: base curve
modules.purpose: Applies a camera-maker style tone curve to make raw files look like the camera JPEG.

modules.name: color reconstruction
modules.purpose: Gives clipped (blown) highlights plausible colour taken from nearby pixels.

modules.name: negadoctor
modules.purpose: Turns scanned color or black-and-white film negatives into positives with film/paper controls.

modules.name: sigmoid
modules.purpose: Maps the bright scene into a pleasing display image with a smooth S-curve (contrast + skew).

modules.name: filmic rgb
modules.purpose: Compresses the scene's dynamic range into the display with a filmic S-curve and protects highlights.
modules.notes: structure ↔ texture: shown when bloom ↔ reconstruct != -100 (not machine-readable). darktable shows some rows only on a tab, in a collapsible section or with a preference; that layout state is not part of visible_when.

modules.name: AgX
modules.purpose: Blender-style filmic tone mapper: sets the exposure range and a contrast curve, with natural highlight desaturation.

rows.label: keep the pivot on the diagonal
rows.action: curve/keep the pivot on the diagonal

modules.name: local contrast
modules.purpose: Boosts or softens fine detail and texture (clarity).

modules.name: rgb curve
modules.purpose: Tone curve in RGB, linked or per red/green/blue channel.

modules.name: tone curve
modules.purpose: Classic tone curve to shape contrast; can also curve Lab color channels.

modules.name: rgb levels
modules.purpose: Sets black, gray and white points on a histogram, linked or per RGB channel.

modules.name: color balance rgb
modules.purpose: Modern colour grading: vibrance, saturation, contrast and separate colour tints for shadows, mid-tones and highlights.

modules.name: color calibration
modules.purpose: Corrects white balance the modern way (by the light source) and mixes the red, green and blue channels, e.g. for colourfulness or black-and-white conversions.

values.label: F9 (Cool White Deluxe 4150 K) – high CRI

rows.label: calibrating with a color checker on the image — not available yet

modules.notes: adaptation: darktable's default is '1 CAT16 (DT_ADAPTATION_CAT16); 4 none (bypass) if another instance already does the CAT or image is monochrome (channelmixerrgb.c:3886-3891)'. illuminant: darktable's default is '2 D (daylight); per image: 10 as shot in camera / 0 pipeline when CAT not applicable (reload_defaults channelmixerrgb.c:3862)'. illuminant: shown when 'as shot in camera' only for raws with matrix support (not machine-readable). temperature: darktable's default is '5003, recomputed from as-shot WB when close to daylight (channelmixerrgb.c:3900)'. hue: darktable's default is 'hue of default x,y (0.333,0.333) - set in reload_defaults'. chroma: darktable's default is 'chroma of default x,y'. darktable shows some rows only on a tab, in a collapsible section or with a preference; that layout state is not part of visible_when.

modules.name: color equalizer
modules.purpose: Changes hue, saturation and brightness of individual colour ranges (reds, oranges, greens, blues ...), like an HSL panel.
modules.notes: hue curve: shown when only while the hue channel is selected (not machine-readable). darktable shows some rows only on a tab, in a collapsible section or with a preference; that layout state is not part of visible_when.

modules.name: color zones
modules.purpose: Adjusts lightness, colourfulness or hue of chosen colour (or brightness) ranges by drawing curves.

modules.name: color harmonizer
modules.purpose: Pulls the image's hues towards a harmonious palette (complementary, triad ...) built around a chosen key colour.
modules.notes: unlabelled in darktable: camera icon, no label. unlabelled in darktable: unlabelled hue slider. unlabelled in darktable: refresh icon, no label. anchor hue: darktable's default is '0.1 stored (UCS hue 0..1); shown converted via _ryb_to_ucs_fast (colorharmonizer.c:855)'. vectorscope two-way sync: darktable's default is 'preference plugins/darkroom/colorharmonizer/sync_to_vectorscope (TRUE)'. hue 1: shown when node 1 exists for the rule (not machine-readable). hue 2: shown when node 2 exists for the rule (not machine-readable). hue 3: shown when node 3 exists for the rule (not machine-readable). hue 4: shown when node 4 exists for the rule (not machine-readable). darktable shows some rows only on a tab, in a collapsible section or with a preference; that layout state is not part of visible_when.

modules.name: rgb primaries
modules.purpose: Shifts the hue and purity of the red, green and blue primaries, and adds an overall tint - a film-like colour character tool.

modules.name: velvia
modules.purpose: Boosts saturation, mostly of less saturated colours, for a punchy slide-film look.

modules.name: color contrast
modules.purpose: Boosts or reduces the separation of green-magenta and blue-yellow colours.

modules.name: color balance
modules.purpose: Classic lift/gamma/gain colour grading: tint shadows, mid-tones and highlights and adjust contrast and saturation.
modules.notes: color control sliders: darktable's default is 'preference plugins/darkroom/colorbalance/controls (HSL)'.

modules.name: monochrome
modules.purpose: Converts to black and white through a virtual colour filter you place on a colour grid.

modules.name: color correction
modules.purpose: Simple split-toning: drag shadow and highlight tint points on a colour grid and set overall saturation.

modules.name: LUT 3D
modules.purpose: Applies a 3D colour lookup table file (.cube, .3dl, HaldCLUT .png or .gmz) for a ready-made look.
modules.notes: unlabelled in darktable: folder button. unlabelled in darktable: file combobox, no label. unlabelled in darktable: LUT name entry + list. lutname: shown when built with G'MIC; a .gmz file selected (not machine-readable).

modules.name: color look up table
modules.purpose: Changes specific colour patches (like a colour chart) to target colours, e.g. to apply a camera or film profile.
modules.notes: lightness: default 0 (relative target mode shows the offset, 0 by default).

modules.name: unbreak input profile
modules.purpose: Fixes flat or log-encoded images by undoing a gamma or applying a log curve.

modules.name: crop
modules.purpose: Cuts away the edges of the photo to improve the framing or change the aspect ratio.

modules.name: rotate and perspective
modules.purpose: Straightens a tilted horizon and fixes converging lines, for example leaning buildings.

custom.hint: draw lines or a rectangle along the building; right-drag a level line to straighten

modules.notes: auto: default 0 (GUI toggle, off until structure detection runs). darktable shows some rows only on a tab, in a collapsible section or with a preference; that layout state is not part of visible_when.

custom.hint: draw lines or a rectangle along the building; right-drag a level line to straighten

modules.name: orientation
modules.purpose: Turns the photo in 90 degree steps or mirrors it.

modules.name: lens correction
modules.purpose: Fixes the distortion, color fringes and dark corners that your lens adds, using the lens profile or data stored in the raw file.
modules.notes: TCA override: shown when !monochrome raw (not machine-readable). TCA red: shown when !monochrome raw (not machine-readable). TCA blue: shown when !monochrome raw (not machine-readable). use latest algorithm: default 0 (GUI check button, unchecked; only offered for old edits). use latest algorithm: shown when md_version != 2 (not machine-readable). distortion: shown when file has warp data (not machine-readable). vignetting: shown when file has vignette data (not machine-readable). TCA red: shown when file has CA data (not machine-readable). TCA blue: shown when file has CA data (not machine-readable).

modules.name: denoise (profiled)
modules.purpose: Reduces noise using a measured noise profile of your camera at that ISO.
modules.notes: compensate highlight preservation: default 1 ($DEFAULT: TRUE in the params struct). compensate highlight preservation: shown when image EXIF highlight preservation shift > 0 (not machine-readable). fix various bugs in algorithm: shown when only when currently FALSE (old edits) (not machine-readable). upgrade profiled transform: shown when only when currently FALSE (old edits) (not machine-readable).

modules.name: sharpen
modules.purpose: Makes edges crisper with a classic unsharp mask.

modules.name: haze removal
modules.purpose: Removes fog and haze to bring back contrast and color in distant parts of the scene.

modules.name: chromatic aberrations
modules.purpose: Removes colored fringes along high-contrast edges on any image.

modules.name: defringe
modules.purpose: Older tool that hides purple or green fringes by desaturating edges.

modules.name: astrophoto denoise
modules.purpose: Strong patch-based noise reduction meant for astrophotography.

modules.name: contrast equalizer
modules.purpose: Boosts or softens contrast and color separately for fine, medium and coarse details.
modules.notes: The curves are the real controls; mix only scales them.

modules.name: surface blur
modules.purpose: Smooths flat areas while keeping edges, for skin or noise.

modules.name: retouch
modules.purpose: Removes dust, blemishes and distractions by cloning, healing, blurring or filling painted areas, optionally per detail scale.

custom.hint: click a shape, then the photo; drag shapes, their source or edges; wheel resizes

rows.label: wavelet decompose and preview levels — not available yet

modules.notes: fill mode: shown when selected tool/shape algorithm == fill (not machine-readable). fill color: shown when algorithm == fill (not machine-readable). brightness: shown when algorithm == fill (not machine-readable). blur type: shown when algorithm == blur (not machine-readable). blur radius: shown when algorithm == blur (not machine-readable).

modules.name: liquify
modules.purpose: Pushes, grows or shrinks parts of the image by dragging warp points, lines and curves.

custom.hint: add points, lines or curves on the photo; drag centres, radii and strength arrows

modules.name: dither or posterize
modules.purpose: Adds fine noise to prevent banding in smooth gradients, or deliberately reduces the number of tones (posterize).

modules.name: external raster masks
modules.purpose: Loads a mask image (PFM/PNG) made elsewhere so other modules can use it as a raster mask.
modules.notes: Publishes a raster mask for other modules' blend section; useful only once masks are supported.

modules.name: grain
modules.purpose: Adds film-like grain texture to the photo.

modules.name: vignetting
modules.purpose: Darkens (or lightens) and desaturates the edges of the frame to draw the eye to the center.

custom.hint: drag the centre or the inner and outer handles on the photo
drag the centre or the inner and outer handles on the photo

modules.name: bloom
modules.purpose: Makes bright areas glow softly into their surroundings for a dreamy look.

modules.name: diffuse or sharpen
modules.purpose: A physics-based tool that can sharpen, blur, add local contrast, bloom or dehaze, mostly driven by its presets.

modules.name: soften
modules.purpose: Blends a blurred, brightened copy over the photo for a soft, glowing (Orton) look.

modules.name: graduated density
modules.purpose: Darkens (or tints) one side of the photo with a soft gradient, like a ND grad filter.

custom.hint: drag the line or its ends on the photo; right-drag draws a new line

modules.name: split-toning
modules.purpose: Tints shadows with one colour and highlights with another.

modules.name: colorize
modules.purpose: Washes the whole image in one colour, e.g. for a sepia or cyanotype look.

modules.name: lowlight vision
modules.purpose: Simulates how the eye sees at night: darker areas lose color and turn bluish.

modules.name: blurs
modules.purpose: Adds realistic lens, motion or gaussian blur.

modules.name: highpass
modules.purpose: Keeps only fine detail; mainly used with a blend mode for sharpening or creative effects.
modules.notes: Produces a grey detail layer; meaningful only with a blend mode such as overlay.

modules.name: lowpass
modules.purpose: Blurs the image; with blend modes it gives soft-glow or local-contrast effects.

modules.name: color mapping
modules.purpose: Transfers the colour mood of one photo onto another by matching colour clusters.
modules.notes: Two-step workflow across two images (acquire source, acquire target).

modules.name: framing
modules.purpose: Adds a solid border (and optional thin frame line) around the photo, optionally to a target aspect ratio.
modules.notes: aspect ratio: default -1.0 (-1 means constant border (DT_IOP_BORDERS_ASPECT_CONSTANT_VALUE, borders.c:49), outside the slider range). aspect ratio: shown when combobox shows 'custom...' when the value matches no preset (not machine-readable). darktable shows some rows only on a tab, in a collapsible section or with a preference; that layout state is not part of visible_when.

modules.name: enlarge canvas
modules.purpose: Adds an empty border around the photo, for example to make room for a frame or a square crop.

modules.name: watermark
modules.purpose: Stamps an SVG/PNG logo or text signature onto the photo.

modules.name: composite
modules.purpose: Places another (processed) photo from the library on top of this one, e.g. for a logo or double exposure.
modules.notes: The overlay is another library image, chosen from the library rather than the file system.

modules.name: censorize
modules.purpose: Pixelates and blurs areas such as faces or license plates for privacy.
modules.notes: Meant for a drawn mask over the area to hide; Omalux has no mask support yet.

modules.name: highlight reconstruction
modules.purpose: Recovers detail and color in blown-out highlights of raw photos.
modules.notes: noise level: shown when (method == guided laplacians && bayer) || (method == segmentation based && rebuild != off) (not machine-readable). iterations: shown when bayer (not machine-readable). inpaint a flat color: shown when bayer (not machine-readable). diameter of reconstruction: shown when bayer (not machine-readable).

modules.name: demosaic
modules.purpose: Turns the raw sensor's single-color pixels into full-color pixels, and can recover fine detail with capture sharpening.
modules.notes: method: shown when Bayer sensor (not machine-readable). method: shown when X-Trans sensor (not machine-readable). method: shown when 4-color Bayer sensor (not machine-readable). method: shown when true monochrome sensor (not machine-readable). dual threshold: shown when dual method (not machine-readable). edge threshold: shown when Bayer (not machine-readable). color smoothing: shown when not passthrough, not 4-Bayer, not dual, not monochrome (not machine-readable). match greens: shown when Bayer; not passthrough (not machine-readable). capture sharpen: shown when not passthrough; not 4-Bayer (not machine-readable). sharp center: shown when cs_boost > 0 (not machine-readable).

modules.name: raw black/white point
modules.purpose: Sets the sensor's black and white levels so the raw data starts from the right zero and maximum.
modules.notes: black level 0: darktable's default is 'image'. black level 1: darktable's default is 'image'. black level 1: shown when !monochrome (not machine-readable). black level 2: darktable's default is 'image'. black level 2: shown when !monochrome (not machine-readable). black level 3: darktable's default is 'image'. black level 3: shown when !monochrome; !sRaw (not machine-readable). white point: darktable's default is 'image'. flat field correction: shown when raw has embedded GainMaps (not machine-readable).

modules.name: hot pixels
modules.purpose: Removes isolated bright dots caused by stuck sensor pixels.

modules.name: raw denoise
modules.purpose: Removes noise from the raw data before colors are reconstructed.

modules.name: raw chromatic aberrations
modules.purpose: Automatically removes colored fringes along edges, working directly on Bayer raw data.

modules.name: input color profile
modules.purpose: Tells darktable which colour profile describes the camera or file, and which working colour space edits happen in.

rows.label: input profile
rows.default: per image: embedded ICC / enhanced or standard color matrix (reload_defaults colorin.c:1686); $DEFAULT DT_COLORSPACE_ENHANCED_MATRIX

modules.name: output color profile
modules.purpose: Converts the edited image into the colour space of the export file (for example sRGB).
modules.notes: darktable shows some rows only on a tab, in a collapsible section or with a preference; that layout state is not part of visible_when.

modules.name: scale pixels
modules.purpose: Corrects images from cameras whose pixels are not square, so the photo is not stretched.

modules.name: basic adjustments
modules.purpose: All-in-one exposure, contrast, brightness, saturation and vibrance panel.

modules.name: levels
modules.purpose: Sets black, middle gray and white points on a histogram (Lab lightness).

modules.name: filmic
modules.purpose: Old (2018) filmic tone mapper: log shaper plus S-curve; replaced by filmic rgb.

modules.name: global tonemap
modules.purpose: Compresses a high-contrast (HDR) image into a viewable range with one global curve.

modules.name: tone mapping
modules.purpose: Old local tone mapping that squeezes high contrast while keeping local detail.

modules.name: fill light
modules.purpose: Lifts or lowers a chosen brightness range with a soft fill light.
modules.notes: center: darktable's black-to-grey gradient slider (relight.c:257).

modules.name: zone system
modules.purpose: Ansel Adams-style zone bar: drag zone borders to remap brightness ranges.

modules.name: invert
modules.purpose: Turns a scanned film negative into a positive using the film base color.

rows.label: color of film material
rows.action: pick color of film material from image

modules.name: channel mixer
modules.purpose: Old tool that mixes the red, green and blue channels into a chosen output channel, e.g. for black-and-white; replaced by color calibration.
modules.notes: destination: darktable's default is '3 (red) - GUI selection only, not stored'. red: default 1 (red destination is the default selection (channelmixer.c:596)). green: default 0 (red destination is the default selection). blue: default 0 (red destination is the default selection).

modules.name: vibrance
modules.purpose: Old module that boosts weak colours more than strong ones; replaced by the vibrance slider in color balance rgb.

modules.name: color transfer
modules.purpose: Obsolete predecessor of color mapping; only lets old edits switch it off.

rows.label: no controls — this module can only be switched off

modules.name: crop and rotate
modules.purpose: Old combined crop, rotate and keystone tool, kept only so older edits still open.
modules.notes: aspect: darktable's default is 'freehand'.

modules.name: spot removal
modules.purpose: Old tool for cloning out sensor dust spots; replaced by retouch.

custom.hint: click a shape, then the photo; drag a spot or its source

modules.name: legacy equalizer
modules.purpose: Old wavelet equalizer kept only so old edits can be switched off.

rows.label: no controls — this module can only be switched off

modules.name: old local contrast
modules.purpose: Old local-contrast tool, replaced by 'local contrast'.
